_about: Option B of new decision D9, for the operator's ~/.claude/settings.json only. Claude Code ignores mask entries, tlsTerminate and allowPlaintextInject in a repository's settings files (CC sandboxing, 'Mask environment variables'). Sandboxed commands see a per-session sentinel; the sandbox proxy substitutes the real GH_TOKEN only on requests to the listed hosts. Requires the token to come from GH_TOKEN, not a keychain login that sandboxed commands can still reach (observed 2026-09-28). Remove this _about key before use.
